content.name: Elixir of Health
entries: When you drink this potion, you are cured of all magical contagions. In addition, the following conditions end on you: {@condition Blinded|SRD52}, {@condition Deafened|SRD52}, {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52}, and {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}.
The clear, red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.
